text:
maya: Heads up — on mobile the TOC in /kb/runtime/quickstart hides several H2 anchors after the i18n build. Also saw two curl examples returning 404 on staging. Anyone owning runtime quickstart?

alex: Which locale/build? Can you paste a quick example of the missing anchor or the curl output? cc @li in case this is from the v2 rewrite.

maya: repro steps: build the site with the ja locale and open `/kb/runtime/quickstart` on mobile UA. The TOC shows the headings but the links jump nowhere. Grepped the HTML and discovered the id changed from `getting-started` -> `GettingStarted`. Example check I ran locally:
```bash
curl -sS https://staging.docs.redwood-inference.internal/kb/runtime/quickstart | grep -n "id=\"getting-started\"" || echo "missing"
# output: missing
```
Also the curl example block in the doc is still showing the old host which returns 404 on staging.

docs-bot: LinkScan report: 2 broken relative links, 1 shortlink redirect loop detected in `/kb/runtime/quickstart` (scan ts: 2026-03-19T21:12:07Z). Probable root cause: localized frontmatter `slug` vs header id casing mismatch.

li: I maintain the runtime quickstart. I pushed the v2 rewrite last week and I think the header IDs got normalized differently (we switched some heading-id generation). I'll open a small PR to restore legacy-style anchors (and update the curl host in the examples). @marta can you review?

sam: If you're restoring legacy anchors, consider adding a fallback mapping in the TOC generator so both new and old ids work for a few releases. That would avoid churn for external links.

oliver: Quick hotfix you can run in the build artifact while PR goes through:
```bash
# naive html patch to normalize casing back to kebab-case for known headings
sed -E -i 's/id=\"GettingStarted\"/id=\"getting-started\"/g' public/**/*.html
```
Not ideal long-term but can get staging green fast.

marta: :thumbsup: happy to review. Please include a tiny pipeline test that checks critical anchor IDs are present for the runtime quickstart (so future rewrites don't regress).

li: Will do all three: restore legacy anchors, add TOC fallback, and add the pipeline test. Opening PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5142. Assigning @marta for review and @alex for a quick smoke. Includes: frontmatter slug fix, curl host update, anchor aliases, and a CI smoke test.

docs-bot: PR 5142 labeled: docs/patch, ci/needs-snapshot. Automated checks queued.

maya: Thanks — once merged can someone trigger a staging deploy? I can re-run the smoke check and close the shortlink incident.

li: Pinged infra-oncall and deploy-bot. Triggering deploy: `/deploy staging docs`

deploy-bot: Deploy queued — job 7821 (docs). ETA ~8m, will post status here.

maya: Verified on staging after the deploy: TOC anchors restored, mobile jump works, and the curl example returns the expected body. Closing loop — thanks all :tada:
